In addition to last week's ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 and the $120 off AirPods Max 2, today's headline news in the 9to5Toys Lunch is that Amazon has dropped the price of AirTag 2 even lower to an all-time low, with the 4-pack now selling for $80 (or $20 each). We also have Apple's 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro for $320 off, as well as this 2TB M5 Pro for $500 off. Also keep an eye out for Anker's brand new SmartTrack Find My wallet card at an all-time low of $25 on Amazon, and LG's 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor, a whopping $2,200 cheaper than the Apple Studio Display XDR (all-time low). See below for details.

The latest AirPods Pro 3 continue at 25% off, with the next generation not expected until 2027

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

Attention everyone! The AirTag 2 price has dropped again, with the 4-pack now at an all-time low of $80 (that's $20 each)

Here's the key point: Amazon is now offering the best price we've tracked for the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 4-pack, at just $20 per tag.

Amazon has now cut the AirTag 2 4-pack to $79.99 with free shipping.

Last week we had been tracking this official bundle at $89.99, then Amazon dropped it further yesterday to $85, and now as the new week begins, the price has hit a new low. Originally priced at $99, it's now nearly 20% off — not a huge amount, but for the latest AirTag 2, it's a pretty significant discount.

At $20 per tag, this bundle is the lowest price we've seen since its release earlier this year.

The single AirTag 2 is still holding at last week's Prime-shipping low of $24, but the 4-pack price has dropped again (once more).

The $20-per-tag price here matches the best open-box deal we saw at Best Buy last week, just for reference.

Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro now $320 off, 2TB M5 Pro $500 off

Beyond the ongoing 25% off AirPods Pro 3 and the AirTag 2 now at the lowest price we've tracked, we also have several notable discounts on the latest MacBook Pro lineup this week. Amazon still has the 2TB M5 Pro for $500 off, and we just spotted a $320 discount on a more affordable 24GB M5 MacBook Pro configuration. Details below.

If you want to step up to the more powerful M5 Pro, Amazon's $500-off model is well worth a look. But if the cheaper M5 suits you better, B&H has an attractive deal on the 14-inch 24GB/1TB configuration:

B&H has once again cut the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB internal storage to $1,899 with free shipping.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (original price $2,219)
  • Includes the upgraded 96W Apple power adapter

This machine is originally priced at $2,199, but B&H is also throwing in the official 96W Apple power adapter — which costs an extra $20 if you configure this machine on Apple's website.

Amazon currently lists the same MacBook Pro configuration at $2,049, bundled with the standard 70W charger.

All told, B&H's deal saves you $320 — on par with the offer we mentioned earlier, and considerably better than Amazon's current price.

However, as noted above, Amazon still has a pretty attractive price on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB at $2,699 — that's $500 off the original $3,199 price, and this deal likely won't last long.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card supports iOS or Android, now $25 — an all-time low on Amazon

Anker recently launched its all-new SmartTrack Find My Card wallet tracker — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and Amazon has now cut it to an all-time low of $25 with Prime shipping.

This product debuted on Amazon last month at $35, was slightly discounted by $5 later that same month, and this is its first significant price cut, setting an all-time low on Amazon.

That's nearly 30% off, matching some of the better wallet tracker deals we've tracked this year.

Personally, I'm a big fan of Nomad's tracker cards — the standard version starts at $35, and the Pro version with 16-month battery life costs $45 to recharge — but regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should keep one in their wallet or card holder. I never leave home without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 packs all the most important features, including wireless charging, and works with both Apple's Find My platform and Google Find Hub. At just 1.7mm thin, with a maximum ring volume of 80 decibels so you can locate it nearby — and of course, it can be loaded directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps to view its location on a map.

Organize your desk with Anker's clever clip-on desktop power strip, now down to just $58

LG's 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits lowest-ever price, a whopping $2,200 cheaper than the Studio Display XDR

We just spotted a deal at B&H dropping LG's 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K monitor to $1,099.99 with free shipping. This monitor launched at an original price of $2,000, and has been selling for as high as $1,597 in recent months. Today's deal essentially matches the all-time low Amazon set earlier this month — and that price is still live. LG today also matched the $1,100 price, giving you a few more options in case one retailer goes out of stock. At today's pricing, the UltraFine evo 6K is also significantly cheaper than Apple's displays. The Studio Display XDR starts at $3,299, making LG's 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor a full $2,200 cheaper. Even the standard Studio Display starts at $1,549, so you can save around $500 while also enjoying a larger 32-inch 6K screen. See below for details.

The LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K is a high-end workstation monitor for creators who want a large, high-resolution screen but don't want to upgrade to Apple's pricier options. Its 6144 x 3456 screen has over 21 million pixels at 224 PPI, providing plenty of space for editing timelines, full-resolution content, tools, and multiple windows. It also covers 99.5% of the Adobe RGB color gamut and supports VESA DisplayHDR 600 for better highlights and contrast. The monitor also offers a rich selection of connectivity options, including Thunderbolt 5, DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI, and USB-C. Mac users can also use LG's Studio Mode, which provides calibrated color presets for more consistent creative work. Overall, it's a fully-featured 6K option for those who want a big screen without paying Apple's monitor prices.

If you don't want to spend more than $1,000 on a new monitor, Woot also has several more affordable Samsung workstation monitor deals. Their range of M-series and other budget models are now discounted, starting from as low as $118.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker works with both iPhone and Android, now down to just $20 (all-time low)
  • This compact UGREEN ultra-slim 45W Nexode Air charger is the thinnest one in my EDC, now just $27
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter on Amazon for $40 (black or white)
  • Chipolo Google Find Hub wallet card with super-button/remote shutter function, now $33
  • UGREEN MagFlow 25W Qi2.2 car charger back up to $28 (original price $40)
  • Acer metal MagSafe golf cart phone holder slashed to $20 with Prime shipping

The latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits an all-time low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of its series of late-summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also offering the lowest-ever price on the new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro, as well as a Prime Day all-time low on the wired version — both at nearly 30% off list price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)

Although the brand later released the $100 Ring Peephole Cam 2K, today we're focusing on some pretty significant deals on their latest Pro-level 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is now back at its Prime Day all-time low price — the first time since the late-June sales event. In fact, this model has now dropped below $200, which is only the second time we've seen that.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro is now seeing its first discount, hitting the same all-time low of $180.

As shown above, both models are priced at $250, and now nearly 30% off — the best deals and lowest prices we've found so far.

The two models are largely identical, featuring up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K imaging to keep an eye on your doorstep; the wireless version comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easier charging and noticeably simpler installation (no wiring required), while the wired version offers "uninterruptible power, uninterruptible protection."

For details, you can check out our launch coverage from last September.

Best Buy launches new tech product deals, NFL Sunday Ticket promotion, and preseason TV deals

Amazon now has $120 off AirPods Max 2 in all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th-anniversary deals bring one of the best prices ever for the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off across all five colors.

Amazon has now cut the Apple AirPods Max 2 to $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, you can now save $120 — the best price we've found from reputable retailers for a brand-new unit.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black version in "premium" open-box condition for $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper, but probably not low enough to justify giving up the brand-new version.

Apple released a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear model won't be refreshed at next month's new product launch, so we may see $120 off this week on what could be Apple's most advanced over-ear headphones yet.

Only one other sale has ever pushed its price lower — Prime Day earlier this summer, when it sold for $30 less than today's deal — but that 4-day sale had very limited and unstable inventory.

Amazon 512GB iPad mini down $450 off new pricing (Renewed Premium condition)

Although we're only just starting to see iPad Air deals this week, discounts on the iPad have recently been essentially nonexistent. That said, we just spotted Amazon offering a 512GB iPad mini in top-tier Renewed Premium condition, a full $450 cheaper than new pricing.

Amazon has now cut the latest 512GB iPad mini A17 to $449 with free shipping.

That means you can now pick up this Apple iPad, originally priced at $899 new, directly from Amazon for $450 less.

It's worth noting that even before the price increase took effect, we'd never seen this model drop below $679 in new condition on Amazon.

As a reminder, Amazon Renewed Premium items are different from regular Renewed listings, or even "premium" condition refurbished units. Its shipping standards are as follows:

  • Screen: if equipped with a screen, it will be completely free of scratches.
  • Body: no cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, or otherwise) visible when viewed from a hand-held distance of 12 inches.
  • Battery: if a battery is included, the battery capacity will exceed 90% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: comes with original or generic accessories and packaging.
  • Warranty: Renewed Premium items come with a 365-day return guarantee.

Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models down $220 today (matching Prime Day pricing)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my top recommendation for iPhone deals, Apple isn't yet selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there — looks like we'll have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new pricing.

Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed inventory has always been the best way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Not only do you save hundreds of dollars, but you also get a year of Amazon Renewed warranty and "over 90% of original battery life" — non-"Premium" Renewed and Refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty, and you won't get the same battery life guarantee.

The 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back with up to $220 off — the 512GB version is $20 cheaper than the price we mentioned earlier:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can pick up a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a one-year Apple warranty starting from $699; the 1TB 16 Pro Max is $1,269 — $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 off the 17 series)
